Keio University participates in the ADB-Japan Scholarship Program, offering fully funded master's study at its graduate schools in economics, business, public policy and media and governance. Candidates apply to Keio's graduate admissions with an ADB-JSP expression, and the scholarship rounds close several months before the September intake.

Programme Highlights

  • Japan's oldest private university hosting ADB-JSP scholars
  • Full funding: tuition, stipend, housing allowance, insurance and travel
  • For nationals of ADB developing member countries
  • Application windows set by the graduate schools per intake

Who Should Apply

ADB member-country nationals with a bachelor's degree and at least two years of relevant work experience, admitted to an eligible Keio master's programme.

Funding and Costs

Full ADB-JSP package: tuition, monthly subsistence allowance, housing, books and medical insurance, plus air travel.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the Keio ADB scholarship page and the relevant graduate school's admissions calendar, then prepare both admission and scholarship documents together. Key deadline information: ADB-JSP rounds at Keio close several months before the September intake — dates on the scholarship page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Keio University

Keio University is Japan's oldest private university, with graduate schools in economics, business, media and governance that participate in the ADB-Japan Scholarship Program.

Official website: https://www.keio.ac.jp

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Closes months before intake - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
